conditions.evidence: Mapping neuroinflammation in vivo with diffusion-MRI
conditions.label: neuroinflammation

modalities.evidence: multi-shell diffusion MRI data were acquired

output.population: Thirty-two male Sprague Dawley rats treated with LPS or saline vehicle
output.summary: Rats given a systemic lipopolysaccharide challenge or saline vehicle and scanned 24 hours later, with T2-weighted and multi-shell diffusion MRI acquired on a 9.4T scanner to map neuroinflammation in vivo.
